instructions: The night before you bake, move the phyllo from the freezer to the fridge to thaw.
On Sunday, or up to 4 days ahead: heat the oven to 350°F. Rub 1 tbsp of the olive oil over the bottom and sides of a 9 by 13-inch baking dish.
Mash the feta with a fork in a bowl. Chop the parsley leaves finely. That should be about 1 cup. Stir the parsley, the mozzarella and 2 of the eggs, beaten, into the feta.
In a large measuring cup, whisk the last egg with the milk, 1/2 cup of water and the remaining 2 tbsp olive oil.

Unroll the phyllo and keep it under a damp towel while you work. Lay 2 sheets in the baking dish, folding any extra over. Spoon about 3 tbsp of the milk mixture over them. Repeat until 6 sheets are in. The pastry will look very wet, and that's right.
Spread the cheese filling evenly over the top sheet.
Add the remaining 6 sheets in pairs, spooning 3 tbsp of the milk mixture over each pair. Pour whatever is left over the top.
Bake for 35 minutes, until the top is golden brown. This makes 12 squares.

Let it cool for 30 minutes, then cut it into 12 squares. They keep in the fridge for up to 4 days in a sealed container. For the freezer, put parchment between the layers and freeze for up to 3 months.

In the morning, put 2 squares on a baking sheet and sprinkle them with a little milk and water. Cover with foil and heat in a 350°F oven for 10 minutes, or 15 minutes from frozen. The microwave makes the pastry soft, so use the oven if you can. Serve warm.
advance_prep_notes: Bake the tray on Sunday, or up to 4 days ahead, and reheat squares through the week. Thaw the phyllo in the fridge the night before.
method_notes: Ozlem's Turkish Table (the lead) wets each pair of phyllo sheets with an egg, milk, water and olive oil mixture, layers in a feta, mozzarella and parsley filling, and bakes at 350°F for about 35 minutes. Almost Turkish Recipes does the same in a round pan with fewer sheets. Cooking Gorgeous gave the storage times (5 days in the fridge, 3 months in the freezer) for its triangle version of the same cheese borek. The lead has no star rating on its page, so this is a fallback, and the sheet count is halved from 24 small sheets to 12 larger US phyllo sheets.
